verdicts.reason: In A, the cream circle behind the can has come loose and sits clipped in the bottom-left corner, running into the NEW pill. That leaves the orange can as a barely visible outline on the orange background, so the key product image is effectively lost. B keeps the can on its circle and reads cleanly from top to bottom, but it still has flaws: the NEW badge is drawn at button size and competes with Try It, the two pills sit almost touching, the can is centred while all the text is left-aligned, and the bottom margin is tight.
